cases.name: clash-full
cases.source:
mode: rule
log-level: info
ipv6: false
allow-lan: false
mixed-port: 7890
tun:
  enable: true
  stack: system
  dns-hijack: ["any:53"]
dns:
  enable: true
  ipv6: false
  enhanced-mode: fake-ip
  fake-ip-range: 198.18.0.1/16
  nameserver: [223.5.5.5, "https://dns.alidns.com/dns-query"]
  nameserver-policy:
    "geosite:cn": 223.5.5.5
hosts:
  router.lan: 192.168.1.1
proxies:
  - {name: HK-SS, type: ss, server: 1.2.3.4, port: 8388, cipher: aes-256-gcm, password: "pw,1", udp: true}
  - name: JP-VMess
    type: vmess
    server: vm.example.com
    port: 443
    uuid: b831381d-6324-4d53-ad4f-8cda48b30811
    alterId: 0
    cipher: auto
    udp: true
    tls: true
    servername: sni.example.com
    network: ws
    ws-opts: {path: /ws, headers: {Host: cdn.example.com}}
  - {name: US-Trojan, type: trojan, server: tr.example.com, port: 443, password: tpw, sni: tr.example.com, udp: true}
  - {name: SG-Hy2, type: hysteria2, server: hy.example.com, port: 8443, password: hpw, sni: hy.example.com, up: "30 Mbps", down: 100}
  - name: WG
    type: wireguard
    server: 162.159.192.1
    port: 2408
    ip: 172.16.0.2
    private-key: aaa=
    public-key: bbb=
    allowed-ips: ['0.0.0.0/0']
    reserved: [1, 2, 3]
proxy-groups:
  - {name: Proxy, type: select, proxies: [HK-SS, JP-VMess, Auto, DIRECT]}
  - {name: Auto, type: url-test, proxies: [HK-SS, US-Trojan], url: 'http://www.gstatic.com/generate_204', interval: 300, tolerance: 50}
  - {name: Fallback, type: fallback, use: [sub1], url: 'http://www.gstatic.com/generate_204', interval: 600}
proxy-providers:
  sub1: {type: http, url: 'https://sub.example.com/a?token=x,y', interval: 3600, path: ./providers/sub1.yaml, health-check: {enable: true, url: 'http://www.gstatic.com/generate_204', interval: 300}}
rule-providers:
  reject: {type: http, behavior: domain, format: yaml, url: 'https://rules.example.com/reject.yaml', path: ./ruleset/reject.yaml, interval: 86400}
rules:
  - RULE-SET,reject,REJECT
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,google.com,Proxy
  - GEOIP,CN,DIRECT
  - IP-CIDR,10.0.0.0/8,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - AND,((DOMAIN,a.example.com),(NETWORK,UDP)),REJECT
  - MATCH,Proxy
expect: url-latency-benchmark=Auto, HK-SS, US-Trojan, check-interval=300, tolerance=50, url=http://www.gstatic.com/generate_204
hysteria2=hy.example.com:8443, down=100, password=hpw, sni=hy.example.com, up=30 Mbps, tag=SG-Hy2
wireguard=162.159.192.1:2408, allowed-ips=["0.0.0.0/0"], ip=172.16.0.2, private-key=aaa=, public-key=bbb=, reserved=[1,2,3], tag=WG
https://rules.example.com/reject.yaml, tag=reject, update-interval=86400, behavior=domain, format=yaml, path=./ruleset/reject.yaml

cases.name: qx
cases.source:
[general]
server_check_url=http://www.gstatic.com/generate_204

[dns]
server=223.5.5.5
server=119.29.29.29

[policy]
static=Main, SS1, VM1, direct
url-latency-benchmark=Auto, SS1, VM1, check-interval=600, tolerance=50

[server_local]
shadowsocks=1.2.3.4:8388, method=aes-256-gcm, password=pw, udp-relay=true, tag=SS1
vmess=vm.example.com:443, method=chacha20-ietf-poly1305, password=b831381d-6324-4d53-ad4f-8cda48b30811, obfs=wss, obfs-host=cdn.example.com, obfs-uri=/ws, tls-host=sni.example.com, tag=VM1
trojan=tr.example.com:443, password=tpw, over-tls=true, tls-host=tr.example.com, tag=TR1

[filter_remote]
https://rules.example.com/ads.list, tag=Ads, force-policy=reject, update-interval=86400, opt-parser=false, enabled=true

[filter_local]
host-suffix, google.com, Main
host-keyword, ads, reject
ip-cidr, 10.0.0.0/8, direct
geoip, cn, direct
final, Main

[rewrite_local]
^https?://ad\.example\.com url reject

[mitm]
hostname = ad.example.com

cases.name: surge
cases.source:
[General]
loglevel = notify
dns-server = 8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1
ipv6 = true

[Proxy]
SS1 = ss, 1.2.3.4, 8388, encrypt-method=aes-256-gcm, password=secret, udp-relay=true
VM1 = vmess, vm.example.com, 443, username=b831381d-6324-4d53-ad4f-8cda48b30811, ws=true, ws-path=/ws, ws-headers=Host:cdn.example.com, tls=true, sni=vm.example.com

[Proxy Group]
Main = select, SS1, VM1, DIRECT
Auto = url-test, SS1, VM1, url=http://www.gstatic.com/generate_204, interval=300, tolerance=50

[Rule]
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,google.com,Main
DOMAIN-KEYWORD,ads,REJECT
GEOIP,CN,DIRECT
FINAL,Main

cases.name: loon
cases.source:
[General]
ipv6 = false

[Proxy]
SS-Loon = Shadowsocks, 5.6.7.8, 8388, method=chacha20-ietf-poly1305, password=pw123
VM-Loon = VMess, vm2.example.com, 443, username=b831381d-6324-4d53-ad4f-8cda48b30811, transport=ws, path=/loon, host=cdn2.example.com, over-tls=true

[Proxy Group]
PROXY = select, SS-Loon, VM-Loon

[Rule]
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,google.com,PROXY
GEOIP,CN,DIRECT
FINAL,PROXY
